_comment: Club shop + services (ShopSystem.js / ShopUI.js). Prices are in wallet dollars. A shift pays about $300-450 (wage $144 + task pay + tips), so a cheap item is about half to one shift and a club project 5-10 shifts. Colours are "#RRGGBB". Run `npm run validate` after editing.

categories.title: Tennis Gear
categories.blurb: Strung, gripped and laced by Jess. Every piece shifts your after-hours game.

categories.title: Lessons
categories.blurb: Private sessions with Coach Rafa. Each one permanently raises your tennis skills.

categories.title: Style
categories.blurb: Uniform variants, hats and shades. Staff dress code: loosely enforced.

categories.title: Cart Shop
categories.blurb: Paint, canopy, lights and a horn with personality for your golf cart.

categories.title: Club Projects
categories.blurb: Chip in toward improvements the whole club will see. Contributions add up over days.

items.name: Club Loaner Racket
items.desc: Scuffed, reliable, smells faintly of the lost-and-found.

items.name: Thunderhead 110
items.desc: Oversized head, huge sweet spot. Hits hard; aims loosely.

items.name: Tour 95 Classic
items.desc: Small head, heavy frame. Puts the ball on a coin, if you swing it.

items.name: Viper Spin 100
items.desc: Open string bed built for heavy topspin. A little jumpy on volleys.

items.name: Greenbriar Pro Edition
items.desc: The club's own frame, lacquered in forest green with gold trim. Heavy, but it does everything.

items.name: Synthetic Gut
items.desc: The default string. Nothing wrong with it. Nothing right either.

items.name: Poly Spin 17
items.desc: Stiff polyester that bites the ball. Arms may file a complaint.

items.name: Natural Gut
items.desc: Buttery feel and pop. Jess strings it by hand and sighs about the price.

items.name: Jess's Hybrid Setup
items.desc: Poly mains, gut crosses, 52 pounds exactly. She keeps your tension on a chart.

items.name: Staff Sneakers
items.desc: Issued with the polo. Good for walking, fine for running.

items.name: Clay Court Sliders
items.desc: Herringbone soles that slide and stop on the red stuff.

items.name: All-Court Cushions
items.desc: Pillowy midsoles for long days: on shift and in the third set.

items.name: Featherlight Racers
items.desc: Barely there. First step like a startled deer, but they tire the legs.

items.name: Tacky Overgrip
items.desc: Sticky white overgrip. Alphabetised on the display, naturally.

items.name: Terry Wristband
items.desc: Keeps the sweat off the grip in the afternoon rush.

items.name: Pro Leather Grip
items.desc: Firm bevels you can feel. Serves get crisper; footwork gets heavier.

items.name: Champion Sweatband Set
items.desc: Gold terry with the club crest. Mostly for the look. Partly for the stamina.

items.name: Staff Polo
items.desc: Forest green, cream collar. Regulation.

items.name: Tournament Whites
items.desc: All-white, green trim. Mrs. Wellington approves (silently).

items.name: Navy Club Polo
items.desc: The evening-staff navy with cream piping.

items.name: Clay Crew Polo
items.desc: Terracotta, for the people who keep the clay courts perfect.

items.name: Warm-up Tracksuit
items.desc: Green track top and striped pants. For chilly mornings and dramatic entrances.

items.name: Gold Trim Polo
items.desc: Green polo with gold collar and cuffs. Only Grounds Leads may wear it.

items.name: White Visor
items.desc: Shade for the eyes, air for the head.

items.name: Sun Bucket Hat
items.desc: Canvas bucket hat with a green band. The veteran members' favourite.

items.name: Terracotta Cap (backwards)
items.desc: Worn backwards, as the juniors insist.

items.name: Retro Headband
items.desc: A red terry headband straight out of a 1980s final.

items.name: Navy Club Cap
items.desc: The staff cap in evening navy.

items.name: Aviator Shades
items.desc: Glare off the clay at 4 PM is no joke.

items.name: Club Cream
items.desc: Factory cream with a green stripe.

items.name: Racing Green
items.desc: Deep green with a gold pinstripe. Goes faster (it doesn't).

items.name: Clay Red
items.desc: Matches the courts, hides the dust.

items.name: Midnight Navy
items.desc: Dark navy with a gold stripe. Very country-club-after-dark.

items.name: Poolside Blue
items.desc: Pale blue with a white stripe, like the pool on a July morning.

items.name: Champagne Gold
items.desc: The paint job the Head of Grounds pretends not to want.

items.name: Forest Canopy
items.desc: Club green with cream trim.

items.name: Cream Canopy
items.desc: Cream top, green trim. Cooler in the afternoon sun.

items.name: Terracotta Canopy
items.desc: Clay-red top with cream trim.

items.name: Cabana Blue Canopy
items.desc: Poolside blue with white trim.

items.name: Round Halogens
items.desc: Warm, round and adequate.

items.name: LED Light Bar
items.desc: A crisp white bar across the nose. Night grooming, sorted.

items.name: Retro Amber Bug-Eyes
items.desc: Big chrome-rimmed amber lamps. Charming. Slightly ridiculous.

items.name: Standard Beep
items.desc: Beep. (Press H while driving.)

items.name: Two-Tone Chime
items.desc: A polite doorbell ding-dong. Members barely mind.

items.name: Vintage Ahooga
items.desc: The classic. Mr. Ashford will hear about it.

items.name: Match-Point Fanfare
items.desc: Four bright notes, like the end of a final.

items.name: Cooler Rack
items.desc: An igloo cooler strapped behind the seat, full of cold water for the courts.

items.name: Ball Basket Rack
items.desc: A wire basket heaped with practice balls on the rear deck.

list.name: Serve Clinic
list.desc: Toss, trophy pose, snap. Rafa counts your bounces out loud.

list.name: Footwork Ladder
list.desc: Split steps, crossovers and a lot of cones.

list.name: Topspin Forehand
list.desc: Low to high, brush up the back of the ball. Again. Again.

list.name: Net & Volley
list.desc: Short punches, soft hands, no swinging at the net.

list.name: On-Court Conditioning
list.desc: Suicides and shadow swings until the third set feels like the first.

projects.name: Koi for the Fountain
projects.desc: Six koi and a few lily pads for the fountain basin.
comments: Have you seen the koi in the fountain? I named the orange one Federer.
The fish in the fountain are very calming. I watched them instead of warming up.
Somebody put koi in the fountain. Genius. Absolute genius.

projects.name: Club Championship Trophy
projects.desc: A proper silver-and-gold cup for the top of the lounge trophy case.
comments: That new trophy in the lounge. I'm winning it this year. Write that down.
The championship cup in the lounge is magnificent. Heavier than it looks, I'm told.
I polished the new trophy with my sleeve. Don't tell anyone.

projects.name: Entrance Flower Beds
projects.desc: Raised brick planters full of blooms either side of the entrance walk.
comments: The flowers at the entrance! First thing you see. Very classy.
Those new planters by the gate make the whole club look five-star.
My wife asked who did the entrance flowers. I said the staff chipped in. She was impressed.

projects.name: Court 1 Scoreboard
projects.desc: A green club scoreboard behind Court 1 showing the live match score.
comments: The scoreboard on Court 1 is fantastic. Now everyone can see me winning.
A real scoreboard! Court 1 feels like a stadium now.
I lost 6-2 on Court 1 and the scoreboard told the whole club. Thanks for that.

projects.name: Patio Heaters & Lanterns
projects.desc: Two tall patio heaters and a row of lanterns under the colonnade for cool evenings.
comments: The string lights on the patio in the evening are just lovely.
Those patio heaters mean I can stay for one more drink. Dangerous.
The patio looks like a wedding every night now. I love it.

projects.name: Practice Hitting Wall
projects.desc: A green practice wall with its own hard pad: the best free hitting partner in tennis.
comments: The new hitting wall never misses. Very rude of it.
I spent an hour on the hitting wall this morning. The wall won.
Best thing at the club, that hitting wall. Never double-books, never complains.

jess_nakamura.title: Pro Shop
greeting: Welcome to the shop. Everything is alphabetised.
Browsing or buying? Either is fine. Buying is finer.
New strings came in. I've already judged them.

rafa_ibarra.title: Lessons with Coach Rafa
greeting: Ready to work? We go until the legs complain.
One hour with me and your forehand will thank you.
Lesson time! Bring water. Bring your patience.
